text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...――
This sensation... racing through the bottomless dark...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Very good. Keep it up.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Using your breathing to dive deep, endlessly deep...
Turning the unseen shadows into your own strength.

Her next race is the Oaks.
Stepping up significantly from the 1600m of the Oka Sho,
it is a grueling 2400m test.

To challenge this abyss—
I had enlisted the help of Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...You want me...
to mentor Desire-san?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd really like to ask you to do it.
Yes, I would love for you to do it.

text_block_list.text:
Red Desire looks up to Manhattan Cafe tremendously.
Having her as a mentor would surely boost her motivation immensely.
choice_data_list: (Still, of course, that's not all there is to it.)

text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe is one who knows the abyss of long-distance races, and masters it.

Stamina building, and mental composure...
I felt she was the only one who could guide Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I shall accept.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san has been
very kind and friendly toward me, after all...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Because what Desire-san seeks is also what 'she' desires.

As if speaking to someone both near and far,
Manhattan Cafe nodded deeply—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... to receive personal instruction
from Cafe-san...!
What a truly blessed saintess I am...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your guidance,
I am ascending to even greater heights...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You possess the talent. The natural gift... to run long distances without being swallowed by the dark.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I simply drew out what was already within you...
just a tiny bit, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's all the fruit of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh... Cafe...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The café latte you brew for me
always puts my soul at peace...

Red Desire quietly peered deep into the cup,
as if diving into the depths of her own mind...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-san. Lately, I feel as though... my saintly powers have grown even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Meaning...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"During the time I spent with you and Buena-san...
I began to feel it strongly."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —An invisible 'something.'

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-san, what flows from you... is a serene, unmistakable resonance."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And... the fateful sympathy with Buena-san,
whom I competed against on that cherry blossom stage.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them, like invisible threads...
lifts me higher—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In this world...
there are many things that exist, even if they cannot be seen.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Even if you don't realize it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's begun taking on races in earnest,
her power must be getting honed to a razor edge...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Let us elevate it further.
...We won't hesitate to lend you a hand, after all."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To knock upon the door of the 'Otherworld,'
an even more tremendous radiance is needed!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san is the protagonist who receives
all the blessings of this world upon herself.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat her...
in the 2,400-meter abyss!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Please, continue to lend us your aid, Cafe-san...—!"

Red Desire's fixation on Buena Vista
was far beyond anything I had imagined.

A slight worry crosses my mind...
Could her judgments and decisions unconsciously be influenced too much by Buena Vista's presence?

However... yearning is
Red Desire's true driving force.
choice_data_list: (For now, I want to believe in her and watch over her.)

text_block_list.text:
And as I continued training with Manhattan Cafe,
eventually—
The day of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Word is that Desire's in top-notch shape.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's become fully capable of rivaling Buena...
Thanks to that, I just can't take my eyes off the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They always give us such nail-biting, heated races.
I'm excited to see who's gonna win today too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "That place" is calling to me...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Now that Cafe-san has elevated my spiritual essence... I will surely overcome this greatest trial."
—I won't lose either.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I've made sure to polish myself to absolute perfection for today, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even if only one of us, you or I,
can reach the place we desire...—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I won't give it up. I will run ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I will definitely reach that 'breathtaking view'!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That is as it should be.
That is truly you, Buena-san. My fellow comrade.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —The trial I must overcome.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I hereby declare that I will surpass you
and conquer the Oaks, without fail."

text_block_list.name: Desire & Buena
text_block_list.text:
"I am—!
I am!"

"Seeking unseen sights, the heroines
stepped out onto the stage of the Yushun Himba (Oaks)—!"
